links.outcome: Unsafe-prompt detection accuracy of safeguard models for elderly-specific risks
links.effect: Fine-tuned Llama-Guard-3 reached up to 96.2% and policy-enhanced gpt-oss-safeguard-20b up to 90.9% unsafe-prompt detection accuracy.
links.quote: We mitigate these failures with two safeguards: a fine-tuned Llama-Guard-3 and a policy-enhanced gpt-oss-safeguard-20b, achieving up to 96.2% and 90.9% unsafe-prompt detection accuracy, respectively.

unlisted_practices: Domain-specific risk taxonomy and benchmark for elderly-specific contextual risks in chatbot interactions

screen.practice: input safety classifier/guard model (prompt guardrails) for elderly-specific risks
screen.reason: Evaluates LLM safety risks specific to older adults (including medical and mental well-being) and benchmarks the effectiveness of dedicated safety guardrail models (fine-tuned Llama-Guard-3 and policy-enhanced guardrails).
